about: Assistant cases on the NovaTeck demo project (run test/novateck.seed.js and test/novateck.finish.js first). expect = groups that must all appear (any alternative of a group, case-insensitive); min = at least n of the listed items; cite = at least one valid source; refusal = the fact is not in the data, the answer must say so; forbid = invented facts (hallucination).
